title.narrative: 23F-SOF - Financing Empowerment of Local Communities and Mitigation Climate Change through a Carbon Credit Business Partnership

description.narrative: The project aims to empower Indigenous People and Local Communities (IPLCs) and mitigate climate change by establishing a mutually beneficial carbon credit business partnership strengthening tenure rights and promoting sustainable forest management. Thus, developing a robust carbon credit scheme ensuring sustained production of high-quality carbon credits, and a transparent and secure developer-vendor-purchaser model. By financing the creation of a scalable business model, the project aims to support long-term sustainable forest management activities. Through a commercially viable and innovative business model, the project contributes to the national goal of linking the Indonesian Social Forestry Program with their ambitious climate actions towards 2030, creating a socially inclusive protection of their forested areas.
